screening_decisions.reason: This is a narrative review and discussion paper examining relationships between radiographic joint destruction, disability, and pathology. It is not a randomized controlled trial or cross-over trial and does not compare glucocorticoid versus non-glucocorticoid arms.

Randomized, double-blind trial comparing oral prednisolone (7.5 mg daily) with placebo in 128 adults with early rheumatoid arthritis. Radiographs of the hands were evaluated by the Larsen index after one and two years. Meets all selection criteria: RCT design, adult RA population, glucocorticoid versus placebo comparison, and standardized radiographic assessment of hands.

This is a Cochrane systematic review of low-dose corticosteroid efficacy in rheumatoid arthritis. It is not a primary randomized controlled trial and does not report original radiographic data from a single comparative study.

Multicentre, double-blind, randomized trial (COBRA) comparing combined therapy including prednisolone (initially 60 mg/day tapered to 7.5 mg/day) plus methotrexate and sulphasalazine versus sulphasalazine alone in 155 adults with early RA. Primary outcomes included the Sharp/Van der Heijde radiographic damage score in hands and feet. Meets all selection criteria.

Two-year randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of prednisone 10 mg/day versus placebo in 81 patients with early active rheumatoid arthritis. Radiologic studies were performed every 6 months to assess progression of joint damage. Meets all selection criteria.

Two-year prospective randomized controlled trial comparing intramuscular depomedrone 120 mg versus placebo in patients with established rheumatoid arthritis. X-ray examination of hands and feet was performed and scored by Larsen's method. Meets all selection criteria with glucocorticoid and non-glucocorticoid arms and standardized radiographic evaluation.

Narrative review article summarizing published data on low-dose corticosteroid use in rheumatoid arthritis. Not a primary randomized controlled trial and does not report original comparative radiographic data.

Editorial/commentary discussing the feasibility of trials and prescribing patterns for corticosteroids in rheumatoid arthritis. Not a randomized controlled trial and contains no original radiographic outcome data.

This is an observational follow-up extension (4-5 years) of the 56-week COBRA randomized trial. During follow-up, patients were seen by their own rheumatologists with no treatment protocol specified, meaning there were no concurrent glucocorticoid and non-glucocorticoid treatment arms at the time of radiographic evaluation. The primary COBRA RCT (study #4) is already included.
Systematic review and meta-analysis of multiple pharmacological interventions for radiological progression in rheumatoid arthritis. Not a primary randomized controlled trial of glucocorticoids.

Randomized trial comparing 7.5 mg/day prednisolone plus initial DMARD versus DMARD alone in patients with early active rheumatoid arthritis. Radiographs of hands and feet were obtained at baseline and after 1 and 2 years and scored by the Sharp/van der Heijde method. Meets all selection criteria.
Narrative review presenting evidence and opinion on the disease-modifying role of corticosteroids. Not a randomized controlled trial and does not report original comparative radiographic data.

Double-blind, placebo-controlled randomized trial of prednisolone 7 mg/day versus placebo in 167 patients with rheumatoid arthritis (duration <3 years). Primary outcome was radiological damage assessed by the modified Sharp method. Meets all selection criteria despite negative findings.

Observational cohort study examining drug continuation probabilities in private practice settings. Not a randomized controlled trial and does not evaluate radiographic progression in a controlled comparative design.

Randomized study comparing methotrexate plus prednisolone (≥10 mg/day) versus methotrexate alone in 62 patients with early active rheumatoid arthritis. X-ray study of hand and foot joints was performed using the Larsen procedure. Meets all selection criteria.
Survey and questionnaire study of corticosteroid prescribing practices among rheumatologists. Not a randomized controlled trial and contains no radiographic outcome data.
Review article focusing on safety data from published reports and clinical trials. Not a primary randomized controlled trial and does not report original comparative radiographic outcomes.

Double-blind study of prednisone 5 mg versus placebo in 34 patients with rheumatoid arthritis. Progression of hand erosions was evaluated radiographically. Meets all selection criteria as an RCT with glucocorticoid versus placebo comparison and standardized hand radiograph assessment.

Double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicentre randomized trial comparing monthly intravenous methylprednisolone pulses versus saline placebo in patients with active rheumatoid arthritis, all started on penicillamine or azathioprine. Radiography was performed to determine the number of erosions at baseline and after 12 months. Meets all selection criteria.

Secondary analysis of a subset of 28 patients from a previously reported randomized placebo-controlled trial of prednisolone (study #2). This is not an independent trial but a sub-study reporting additional radiographic analyses from an already-included RCT.

Multicenter randomized controlled trial (BeST study) of 508 patients allocated to four treatment strategies, including initial combination therapy with tapered high-dose prednisone (group 3) versus strategies without initial prednisone. Total Sharp/Van der Heijde radiographic joint score was assessed. Meets all selection criteria with glucocorticoid and non-glucocorticoid arms and standardized radiographic evaluation.

Multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled randomized trial of prednisolone 5 mg/day versus placebo in patients with early rheumatoid arthritis receiving concomitant DMARD therapy. Hand and foot radiographs were evaluated by the Ratingen score and modified Sharp/van der Heijde score. Meets all selection criteria.

Meta-analysis comparing second-line disease-modifying drugs (methotrexate, gold, sulfasalazine, etc.) in rheumatoid arthritis. Not a primary randomized controlled trial of glucocorticoids versus control and does not report original radiographic data from a glucocorticoid comparison.

This reports a third year of follow-up after blinded discontinuation of study prednisolone in the same patient cohort as study #2. During this follow-up year, study medication was stopped in both groups, so there were no concurrent glucocorticoid and non-glucocorticoid treatment arms. The primary 2-year RCT (study #2) is already included.

Randomized trial comparing DMARD plus prednisolone versus DMARD alone in 102 patients with active rheumatoid arthritis. Radiographs of the hands were assessed by the Larsen score. Meets all selection criteria as an RCT with glucocorticoid and non-glucocorticoid arms and standardized hand radiograph evaluation.

Review article examining the relationship between joint damage and disability in rheumatoid arthritis. Not a randomized controlled trial and does not report original comparative radiographic data from glucocorticoid versus control arms.
